انقبضت (form VII)
# اِنْقَبَضْتُ (inqabaḍtu) /in.qa.badˤ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْقَبَضَ (inqabaḍa)
# اِنْقَبَضْتَ (inqabaḍta) /in.qa.badˤ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْقَبَضَ (inqabaḍa)
# اِنْقَبَضْتِ (inqabaḍti) /in.qa.badˤ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْقَبَضَ (inqabaḍa)
# اِنْقَبَضَتْ (inqabaḍat) /in.qa.ba.dˤat/: third-pe
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
